text:
Hi there, and thank you for contacting Leafy! Congratulations on your new ZZ plant. 🌿

Good news: you ordered about 20 minutes ago, so you're still inside the **2-hour window** for changing an order for free. That leaves you roughly 1 hour 40 minutes.

- Go to **"My Orders"** on the website or app and open your order.
- Make the change there, if the order shows the option to edit it.

I can't confirm from my end that adding a new item is one of the edit options, so please check in "My Orders" first. If you don't see it, reach out to us and we'll see what we can do. Once the 2 hours are up, the order goes into the packing queue and can't be changed online. Support can try to intercept it before it ships, but that isn't guaranteed.

A few things that might help:
- Your ZZ plant ships in a plastic nursery pot with drainage holes. Decorative pots are sold separately, so a pot is a nice addition.
- If you have a promo code, it can't be added after ordering.
- Orders with plants and non-living items ship together on a plant shipping day (Monday to Wednesday).

If you get stuck, I'm happy to help further. Chat is open 8am to 8pm Mon to Sat, and you can email help@leafy.example (we reply within 1 business day).

Happy planting, and please reach out any time! 🌱
